name: jinli-minigame
description: 锦鲤前程 微信小游戏客户端（原生 Canvas2D，不依赖游戏引擎与编辑器）

scripts.codegen: node scripts/generate-shop-catalog.mjs && node scripts/generate-legal-config.mjs && node scripts/generate-run-arena.mjs && node scripts/copy-stage-assets.mjs
scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-shop-catalog.mjs && node scripts/generate-legal-config.mjs && node scripts/copy-stage-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-run-arena.mjs --check && node --import ./tests/register-hook.mjs --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node tests/bundle-smoke.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir .scratch/smoke && node --import ./tests/register-dist-hook.mjs tests/share-card-smoke.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-dist-hook.mjs tests/render-smoke.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-dist-hook.mjs tests/menu-smoke.mjs && node --import ./tests/register-dist-hook.mjs tests/rules-smoke.mjs
